idea: Regress load on weekday plus heating/cooling degree days
agent_reply:
I replaced the 7-day average in `model.py` with a least-squares fit on day of week plus heating and cooling degrees. `check.py` passes. On the practice year (Jul 2023 – Jun 2024, walked forward monthly) the average miss is 3.04 MWh, against 5.782 for the baseline. I haven't run the judge's reshuffle test, so I don't know if it clears the 95% bar.

The fit has one level per weekday and two temperature terms: degrees below 17°C and degrees above 21°C. The 17 and 21 cut-offs are rough guesses from the load-by-temperature averages, not tuned.

IDEA: Regress load on weekday plus heating/cooling degree days
